title: tac.threats
description: The ranked threat list of a side (the compact 10-line answer): highest threat first with aspect, closure, range to the threatened unit and time to closest approach; optionally only threats to one unit. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

view.description: Picture to read: a team name (your own side unless you are a human, referee or director), or "god" for the truth (needs privilege or fog off). Defaults to the session's side.

to.description: only threats to this own unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id or an exact unit name.

units.description: distance units for text: nm (naval: nm, kt, ft) or km (metric)

format.description: "compact" = readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured rows
